SELECT i_item_id, ca_country, ca_state, ca_county, 
       AVG(CAST(cs_quantity AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg1, 
       AVG(CAST(cs_list_price AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg2, 
       AVG(CAST(cs_coupon_amt AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg3, 
       AVG(CAST(cs_sales_price AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg4, 
       AVG(CAST(cs_net_profit AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg5, 
       AVG(CAST(c_birth_year AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg6, 
       AVG(CAST(cd1.cd_dep_count AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg7 
FROM (
    SELECT cs_item_sk, cs_bill_customer_sk, cs_bill_cdemo_sk, cs_sold_date_sk, 
           c.c_customer_sk, c.c_birth_year, c.c_current_cdemo_sk, c.c_current_addr_sk,
           cd1.cd_demo_sk, cd1.cd_dep_count,
           ca.ca_address_sk, ca.ca_state, ca.ca_country, ca.ca_county,
           d.d_date_sk
    FROM (
        SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_dep_count
        FROM customer_demographics
        WHERE cd_gender = 'F' AND cd_education_status = 'Primary'
    ) AS cd1
    CROSS JOIN (
        SELECT c_customer_sk, c_birth_year, c_current_cdemo_sk, c_current_addr_sk
        FROM customer
        WHERE c_birth_month IN (1, 3, 7, 11, 10, 4)
    ) AS c
    CROSS JOIN (
        SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_state, ca_country, ca_county
        FROM customer_address
        WHERE ca_state IN ('AL', 'MO', 'TN', 'GA', 'MT', 'IN', 'CA')
    ) AS ca
    CROSS JOIN (
        SELECT d_date_sk
        FROM date_dim
        WHERE d_year = 2001
    ) AS d
    CROSS JOIN item
    CROSS JOIN catalog_sales
    WHERE catalog_sales.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk
      AND catalog_sales.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
      AND catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
      AND catalog_sales.cs_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
) AS base
GROUP BY ROLLUP (i_item_id, ca_country, ca_state, ca_county) 
ORDER BY ca_country, ca_state, ca_county, i_item_id 
LIMIT 100
